place.name: Juan Crisóstomo Falcón National Park
place.description: The Juan Crisostomo Falcón National Park (Spanish: Parque nacional Juan Crisóstomo Falcón), also known as the Sierra de San Luis, is in the southern part of the Falcón state in Venezuela. It has an area of 20,000 hectares (49,000 acres) covering the municipalities of Bolívar, Petit, and part of the municipalities of Colina and Miranda.
